tasks.title: Produce evidence-linked algorithmic stack proposals
tasks.goal: Turn an inventory into a reviewable proposal using a supported stack-owned analyzer.
steps: Bind an explicit supported stack analyzer to the captured inventory; keep language/tool-specific recognition outside generic inventory.
Infer only rules justified by observed manifests/source evidence; return proposed facts/questions/options with assumptions and exact source locations.
Expose proposal inspection through shared services; retain unknown languages and ambiguous signals as partial information rather than invented intent.
positive_cases: A supported existing project yields reproducible evidence-linked proposals.
Existing desired intent is shown beside proposals rather than overwritten.
negative_cases: Unsupported language or contradictory markers cannot produce an authoritative complete configuration.
Proposal generation cannot install a stack or promote facts.
acceptance: Every proposed change has evidence and an explicit assumption/confidence genre.
Algorithmic mode completes without provider construction or tool execution.
tasks.safe_stop: Inspectable algorithmic proposal exists; authored intent unchanged.
notes: Schema changes: inspect the existing codegen entrypoint before regeneration; never hand-edit generated types or invent a new codegen command. The listed check-codegen and wire-diff commands are existing self-check gates.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

tasks.title: Expose optional assist as a separate explicit operation
tasks.goal: Add optional advisory enrichment while preserving a complete provider-free algorithmic path.
steps: Use the existing explicit enhancement mode contract and M-16 operation authority; off is the default and does not read credentials.
Let an explicitly admitted assist consume the captured algorithmic proposal and return separately attributed suggestions, never rewrite observed evidence.
Implement unavailable/failure behavior and typed provenance through a deterministic fake provider; keep promotion a distinct operation.
positive_cases: Off mode returns the full algorithmic answer with zero provider calls.
Explicit assist adds visibly advisory suggestions tied to the same snapshot.
negative_cases: Configured credentials or endpoint alone cannot activate assistance.
Provider failure cannot silently replace evidence or auto-promote output.
acceptance: Mode/call instrumentation proves the default path is complete and provider-free.
Advisory output remains distinguishable from observed facts and owner choices.
tasks.safe_stop: Optional assist contract is proven with fake provider; no model/API spend.
notes: Schema changes: inspect the existing codegen entrypoint before regeneration; never hand-edit generated types or invent a new codegen command. The listed check-codegen and wire-diff commands are existing self-check gates.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.
